text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Median over the 8 Primaries' latest season-years of the share of noise draws flagged. The pale lines are the two shapes that some fit contains, and the black line is a load shaped like solar generation. Dashed rules: power 0.8 and amplitude 0.25.'
text.tspan: Median over the 8 Primaries' latest season-years of the share of noise draws flagged.
The pale lines are the two shapes that some fit contains, and the black line is a load
shaped like solar generation. Dashed rules: power 0.8 and amplitude 0.25.
